title: Walkthrough Scene Planner
purpose: Project a resolved walkthrough story and repository presentation inventory into an ordered visual scene plan.
trigger: a resolved walkthrough story is submitted with its repository presentation inventory and an authorized scene-planning policy
desiredOutcome: every required story beat is represented by an admitted, semantically anchored, ordered visual scene
constraints: the planner must not emit browser selectors or platform-specific navigation instructions
every scene must reference an admitted presentation asset
every required story beat must have declared visual coverage
scene ordering must be resolved before browser presentation authority is requested
no scene may invent repository material absent from the presentation inventory
all capability-specific decisions are declared in semantic authority
runtime bodies execute resolved authority without authored domain decisions
